name: The Mystery of The Crystal Mountain
source:
Prepare to enter a once-in-a-lifetime Slavic tale with magic, dragons, and helpless women. You are Volebor, a half-god, yet you live a life more akin to studying and one-night hookups than thrilling adventures and climaxes. But that is going to happen soon! Everything changes when your father shows up and assigns you a duty.

[From [url=https://eroticgamingparadise.itch.io/the-mystery-of-the-crystal-mountain]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
准备好进入一个千载难逢的斯拉夫故事，其中有魔法、龙和无助的女人。你是沃勒博尔，一个半神，但你的生活更像是学习和一夜的勾搭，而不是惊心动魄的冒险和高潮。但这很快就会发生！当你父亲出现并给你分配任务时，一切都改变了。

[来自[url=https://eroticgamingparadise.itch.io/the-mystery-of-the-crystal-mountain]Itch.io[/url]]
